verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
Scripture says, ‘Honor your father and mother.’ This is the first command with a promise:
‘so that things may go well for you and you may live long on the earth.’
Parents, don't provoke your children to anger. Bring them up with the Lord's discipline and instruction.
Enslaved people, obey your earthly masters with respect and sincerity, as you would Christ.
Don't work only when someone is watching, just to please people. As Christ's servants, do God's will from your heart.
Serve willingly, as if you were serving the Lord and not people,
because you know that the Lord will reward each person for whatever good they do, whether enslaved or free.
Masters, treat them the same way. Stop threatening them. Remember that both they and you have the same Master in heaven, and he shows no favoritism.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
Put on all of God's armor so you can stand against the devil's schemes.
Our struggle isn't against people, but against rulers, authorities, the powers of this dark world, and spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
So put on all of God's armor, so that when the evil day comes, you can stand your ground, and after you've done everything, still stand.
Stand firm, with truth buckled around your waist and righteousness as your armor,
and with your feet ready to share the Good News of peace.
Most of all, take up the shield of faith, which can put out all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word.
Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and request. Stay alert and keep praying for all God's people.
Pray for me too, that whenever I speak, God will give me the right words to boldly make known the mystery of the Good News,
for which I'm an ambassador in chains. Pray that I'll speak boldly about it, as I should.
Tychicus, our dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything about how I'm doing.
I sent him to you for this very reason: so you'll know how we're doing and he'll encourage your hearts.
Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with undying love. Amen.
